items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: And also on your staff there, you also had Malcolm Nash, dance director; Archie Savage, dance director; Laura Bowman, dramatic arts. She came out of the Lafayette Players.

ctx.x: "Hollywood" McCoy. I think he was the first colored boy born out there. He was born out there--'13, I think, '12 or '13. 'Course there might have been more but they say...they say that... you know.
And also on your staff there, you also had Malcolm Nash, dance director; Archie Savage, dance director; Laura Bowman, dramatic arts. She came out of the Lafayette Players.
